courses.title: Calculus with Analytic Geometry I
courses.description: Single-variable calculus focused on differentiation and its applications.
courses.prereq_text: None listed. Recommended: completion of Department of Mathematics' Guided Self-Placement.

courses.title: Calculus with Analytic Geometry II
courses.description: Continues single-variable calculus with an emphasis on integration and applications.
courses.prereq_text: Either minimum grade of 2.0 in MATH 124, score of 3 on AB advanced placement test, or score of 3 on BC advanced placement test.

courses.title: Accelerated (Honors) Calculus

courses.title: Accelerated (Honors) Calculus

courses.prereq_text: A minimum grade of 2.0 in MATH 125.

courses.title: Matrix Algebra with Applications

courses.prereq_text: None listed. Recommended: completion of Department of Mathematics' Guided Self-Placement.

courses.title: Advanced Multivariable Calculus

courses.title: Introduction to Differential Equations and Applications

courses.description: Fundamentals of electromagnetism with lab, for physical science and engineering majors.

courses.title: Honors Electromagnetism
